Steps

The pages move over one weekend; the old wiki stays readable until the new one opens.

  1. Freeze edits on the old wiki

    On Friday evening.

  2. Copy the pages and check the links
  3. Point the team's bookmarks at the new host

Who does what

Copy

Copies the pages on Saturday and keeps a list of what failed.

Links

Runs the link check and fixes what it finds.

Bookmarks

Sends the new address to the team on Monday morning.
